","storage_client.py":"import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional

import boto3
from botocore.config import Config


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StorageConfig:
    aws_region: str
    aws_access_key_id: Optional[str]
    aws_secret_access_key: Optional[str]
    aws_session_token: Optional[str]
    s3_endpoint_url: Optional[str]


def get_storage_config() -> StorageConfig:
    return StorageConfig(
        aws_region=os.getenv("AWS_REGION", os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION", "us-east-1")),
        aws_access_key_id=os.getenv("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"),
        aws_secret_access_key=os.getenv("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"),
        aws_session_token=os.getenv("AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"),
        s3_endpoint_url=os.getenv("S3_ENDPOINT_URL"),
    )


def create_s3_client(config: Optional[StorageConfig] = None):
    cfg = config or get_storage_config()
    session = boto3.session.Session(
        aws_access_key_id=cfg.aws_access_key_id,
        aws_secret_access_key=cfg.aws_secret_access_key,
        aws_session_token=cfg.aws_session_token,
        region_name=cfg.aws_region,
    )
    return session.client("s3", endpoint_url=cfg.s3_endpoint_url, config=Config(signature_version="s3v4"))
","storage_models.py":"from dataclasses import dataclass
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, BinaryIO, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Union


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UploadResult:
    bucket: str
    key: str
    size: int
    etag: Optional[str]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PresignedURL:
    url: str
    expires_in_seconds: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StorageObject:
    key: str
    size: Optional[int] = None
    last_modified: Optional[str] = None
    etag: Optional[str] = None


def read_bytes_source(source: Union[str, bytes, bytearray, BinaryIO]) -> bytes:
    if isinstance(source, (bytes, bytearray)):
        return bytes(source)
    if isinstance(source, str):
        return Path(source).read_bytes()
    data = source.read()
    return data if isinstance(data, bytes) else bytes(data)


def normalize_head_object_response(response: Dict[str, Any], bucket: str, key: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "bucket": bucket,
        "key": key,
        "content_length": response.get("ContentLength"),
        "content_type": response.get("ContentType"),
        "etag": response.get("ETag"),
        "last_modified": response.get("LastModified").isoformat() if response.get("LastModified") else None,
        "metadata": response.get("Metadata", {}),
        "storage_class": response.get("StorageClass"),
    }


def normalize_list_objects_response(response: Dict[str, Any], bucket: str, prefix: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    contents = response.get("Contents", []) or []
    objects: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in contents:
        objects.append(
            {
                "key": item.get("Key"),
                "size": item.get("Size"),
                "last_modified": item.get("LastModified").isoformat() if item.get("LastModified") else None,
                "etag": item.get("ETag"),
                "storage_class": item.get("StorageClass"),
            }
        )
    return {
        "bucket": bucket,
        "prefix": prefix,
        "key_count": response.get("KeyCount", len(objects)),
        "is_truncated": response.get("IsTruncated", False),
        "next_continuation_token": response.get("NextContinuationToken"),
        "objects": objects,
    }

import boto3

from storage_client import create_s3_client, get_storage_config
from storage_models import read_bytes_source


def stored_document_ocr(bucket: str, key: str, textract_document_format: str = "PDF") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    config = get_storage_config()
    s3_client = create_s3_client(config)
    textract = boto3.client("textract", region_name=config.aws_region)
    obj = s3_client.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
    body = obj["Body"].read()
    response = textract.detect_document_text(
        Document={"Bytes": body}
    )
    blocks = response.get("Blocks", [])
    lines = [b["Text"] for b in blocks if b.get("BlockType") == "LINE" and b.get("Text")]
    return {"bucket": bucket, "key": key, "lines": lines, "text": "\n".join(lines)}

from storage_client import create_s3_client, get_storage_config


def stored_text_translate(bucket: str, key: str, target_language_code: str = "en") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    config = get_storage_config()
    s3_client = create_s3_client(config)
    translate = boto3.client("translate", region_name=config.aws_region)
    obj = s3_client.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
    source_text = obj["Body"].read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
    response = translate.translate_text(
        Text=source_text,
        SourceLanguageCode="auto",
        TargetLanguageCode=target_language_code,
    )
    return {
        "bucket": bucket,
        "key": key,
        "source_text": source_text,
        "translated_text": response.get("TranslatedText", ""),
        "source_language_code": response.get("SourceLanguageCode"),
        "target_language_code": response.get("TargetLanguageCode", target_language_code),
    }

import boto3

from storage_client import create_s3_client, get_storage_config


def stored_asset_summary(bucket: str, key: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    config = get_storage_config()
    s3_client = create_s3_client(config)
    comprehend = boto3.client("comprehend", region_name=config.aws_region)
    obj = s3_client.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
    text = obj["Body"].read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
    summary = text[:400]
    key_phrases = []
    if text.strip():
        resp = comprehend.detect_key_phrases(Text=text[:4500], LanguageCode="en")
        key_phrases = [p.get("Text") for p in resp.get("KeyPhrases", []) if p.get("Text")]
    return {"bucket": bucket, "key": key, "summary": summary, "key_phrases": key_phrases}
","asset_metadata_embedding.py":"from typing import Any, Dict, List

from openai import OpenAI

from storage_client import create_s3_client, get_storage_config


def asset_metadata_embedding(bucket: str, key: str, extra_text: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    config = get_storage_config()
    s3_client = create_s3_client(config)
    obj = s3_client.head_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
    metadata = obj.get("Metadata", {})
    parts = [f"bucket:{bucket}", f"key:{key}"] + [f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in metadata.items()]
    if extra_text:
        parts.append(extra_text)
    text = "\n".join(parts)
    client = OpenAI()
    embedding = client.embeddings.create(model="text-embedding-3-small", input=text)
    vector = embedding.data[0].embedding if embedding.data else []
    return {"bucket": bucket, "key": key, "text": text, "embedding": vector, "dimension": len(vector)}
